title: The restriction of an m-regular coherent sheaf to a hyperplane is m-regular
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the induction situation of the section, m-regularity of F on projective n-space implies m-regularity of the restricted sheaf G on the hyperplane. The proof uses that the cohomology of the pushforward of G agrees with that of G on the hyperplane, writes the connecting sequence H^i(P^n, F(m-i)) -> H^i(H, G(m-i)) -> H^{i+1}(P^n, F(m-1-i)) valid for i at least 1, and reads the vanishing of the middle term off the vanishings supplied by m-regularity of F on the two outer terms (proof lines 6645-6654). H2: identifying the cohomology of the pushforward with that of G and reading the middle vanishing off the connecting sequence is the substance; the tail phrase simply marks the routine elimination.
